items.title: BOJ expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to fresh three-decade high: CNBC survey
items.description: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.

items.title: Indonesia's new finance minister faces an uphill battle on fiscal credibility
items.description: Nazara, sworn in hours after Purbaya's dismissal, spent seven years as deputy finance minister and led the ministry's fiscal policy agency from 2015 to 2019.

items.title: House to vote on bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
items.description: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

items.title: Inside South Korea’s university programs offering a direct route to Samsung and SK Hynix
items.description: Companies are helping universities develop courses, provide financial support and create pathways through which qualifying students can join them.

items.title: Why de-dollarization discussions are more talk, less action
items.description: BRICS leaders have asserted the need to use local currencies in intra-BRICS trade to cut dependency on dollar.

items.title: Musk urges top AI labs, Chinese companies to test each other's models amid calls for slowdown
items.description: Elon Musk called for the leading AI labs to peer review each others' models before they're released to the public as a way to evaluate their safety.

items.title: Iran war has cost on average $246 million per day in its first five months, CBO finds
items.description: CBO estimates the Iran war cost the Pentagon $38.1 billion through Aug. 1 and could cost another $2 billion to $3 billion each additional month.

items.title: Nvidia's Huang diverges with CEOs of Anthropic, OpenAI on AI safety at Dreamforce
items.description: Comments from the two tech leaders landed days after Anthropic's Dario Amodei published an essay urging the AI industry to slow the pace of model development.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Huang attending Trump's state dinner for China's Xi: Source
items.description: Jensen Huang appeared to side with Trump as the president pushed back on tech CEOs' warnings about the risks of rapid AI advancement.

items.title: Trump says Kennedy Center will stay closed without renovation unless his name is added back
items.description: The ruling comes four months after the same judge ordered that the Kennedy Center could not be renamed to include President Trump's name.

items.title: Americans' incomes rose and poverty fell in 2025, Census Bureau says
items.description: The data comes as the Federal Reserve is considering interest-rate increases that could slow economic growth.

items.title: Senate cloture vote on Clarity Act fails, dealing regulatory blow to crypto industry
items.description: The Senate on Tuesday voted to block the Clarity Act from advancing, dealing a blow to the crypto industry's push for a comprehensive market framework.

items.title: Trump Account contributions have a Dec. 31 deadline — and employers can complicate the math
items.description: Employers can offer Trump Account employee benefits via direct contributions or by allowing workers to make pre-tax contributions to a child's account.

items.title: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic discussing collaboration on AI safety issues

items.description: Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen, meanwhile, carried out renewed strikes on Saudi Arabia this week.

items.title: Saudi pipeline closure is a brief interruption that will last days, U.S. Energy secretary tells CNBC

items.title: Ford increases V-8 engine availability, lowers performance prices for 2027 F-150 trucks
